analysis:
Only CHANGELOG.md head text was supplied, covering lines 224-597. It is documentation, so no executable security behavior was reviewed. The entries describe code, workflow and threat-model-relevant changes whose source and patch hunks were not provided, so they are unverified and coverage is limited.

Entries the integration pass should check against the actual code changes:
- Frozen legacy MDM cohort (lines 269-280, TB-009/TB-011, T-036, T-052, T-055, T-060): a linked Bearer token plus an SE-key proof for /v1/enroll; App Attest required for noncohort owner routes; macOS 27+ and qualified App Attest required for base rewards.
- Top-level user, metadata, safety_identifier and prompt_cache_key removed from provider-bound bodies (line 251, T-003/T-051): the entry states nested content is not anonymized.
- Cache-routing persistence of SSD holders and demand in the database (lines 443-449), the SSD write budget raised from 150 to 750 GB/day (line 486), and the prefix-cache TTL raised to 30 minutes (line 568, described as a SEC-035 re-acceptance). All relate to T-041, and the persistence entry is a possible threat-model update.
- Coordinator legacy-compat cleanup (lines 537-557): fail-closed attestation challenges (status_signature and secure_boot_enabled), App Attest protocol 3 only, the removed earnings lookup (T-031), and the removed telemetry route.
- Non-streaming provider output bounded by bytes and frames (line 394).
- Cache-read pricing and billing changes (lines 518-526, T-051/payments).
- Stripe payout migration (lines 309-313, TB-008).
- Advisory PR review workflow and spend caps (lines 302-308, 479-482): runs the trusted base revision only.

No contradictions with the canonical threat model were identified from the text alone.
